items.subject: seg-0027
items.question: segment_materiality
items.asked: Judge only the SEGMENT UNDER REVIEW, reading the preceding turns for context. Does that segment contribute anything an equity analyst should record as a claim about the business? An answer that only makes sense beside the question before it is still material if the answer itself carries the content.
items.why: Jev's best reading is 'material' at 61%, not the 'immaterial' the record implies.
